documents.title: Getting Started
documents.body: Learn how to use pagify to build your documentation site. Installation # Install via Go go install github.com/hieudoanm/pagify@latest # Or build from source make build Create Your First Site # Scaffold a starter project pagify init my-docs # Build it pagify build ./my-docs/docs # Preview locally pagify serve ./my-docs/docs Write Content Create .md files in your content directory: --- title: My Page description: A helpful description order: 1 --- # Page Title Your content here... Frontmatter Options Field Description title Page title (overrides first # Heading ) description SEO meta description order Sort order in navigation label Custom nav label draft Set true to exclude from build Build & Deploy # Build for production pagify build ./docs --output ./dist # Deploy ./dist to GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages... The dist/ directory contains only static files — no server required.

documents.title: Configuration
documents.body: Create pagify.yaml at your content root to customize the site. All fields are optional. title: My Documentation language: en basePath: /my-repo # For GitHub Pages project sites theme: light # light | dark | auto footer: '© 2024 Example' Fields Field Default Description title Directory name Site title in header/meta language en HTML lang attribute basePath / URL prefix for GitHub Pages project sites theme auto Initial color scheme footer — Footer text (supports Markdown) Example: GitHub Pages For a repo at github.com/user/my-docs : title: My Project Docs basePath: /my-docs Then in your repo settings, enable GitHub Pages from the dist/ folder. No Config Needed A site with no pagify.yaml builds with sensible defaults: Title from directory name Auto theme (follows OS) No footer Root path /

documents.title: Installation
documents.body: Requirements Go 1.21+ (for building from source) No Node.js, npm, or Python required Methods Go Install (Recommended) go install github.com/hieudoanm/pagify@latest Ensure $(go env GOPATH)/bin is in your $PATH . Build from Source git clone https://github.com/hieudoanm/pagify cd pagify make build ./bin/pagify --help Homebrew (macOS) brew tap hieudoanm/pagify brew install pagify Verify Installation pagify --version Should output something like pagify version 0.1.0 .

documents.title: Basic Docs
documents.body: This is a minimal pagify example showing how to create a documentation site with zero configuration. Quick Start pagify build ./docs The output appears in ./dist — ready to deploy anywhere. Features Zero config — just Markdown files in a directory Clean URLs — no .html extensions Auto navigation — built from your file tree Search — client-side, no backend needed Dark mode — automatic + manual toggle Responsive — works on mobile, tablet, desktop Project Structure docs/ ├── index.md # Home page ├── getting-started.md # First guide ├── guide/ │ ├── index.md # Section landing │ ├── installation.md │ └── configuration.md └── reference/ └── cli.md Next Steps Read the Getting Started guide to learn more.
